head: CDJ 实时驱动的舞池主视觉：灯光跟着 BPM 和波形呼吸
metaTitle: Pillbox 舞池主视觉 — 鼠王 Ratking
metaDescription: 北京 Pillbox 俱乐部的舞池灯光装置：150 米点控灯带、2815 个像素点、638nm 激光，CDJ 实时驱动，预算约 7 万元，两周落地。

infos.label: 类型
infos.value: 舞池主视觉 / 新媒体灯光装置

sections.label: 现场
sections.html:
Pillbox 是北京的一间地下俱乐部。舞池上方要一组能跟着 DJ 走的主视觉，但不能停业施工；预算约 7 万元，周期 2 周。

前期沟通不到 10 小时。方案、点位、配电和控制链路先在图纸上定完，再进场。现场施工 3 人 × 5 天，共 15 个工，我的角色是沟通、设计、编程、落地，全程一个人负责。

sections.label: 设计
sections.html:
舞池上方悬挂一组透明螺旋管道结构，管内穿入 150 米点控灯带和线缆；钨丝灯、激光和旋转警灯沿结构布置。

装置不跑预设。CDJ 的波形和 BPM 实时进入系统，灯带和激光跟着节拍走。DJ 换歌、变速、推高潮，舞池的光会同步变化。交付后又加入 iPad 控制界面，甲方可以无线调整颜色。

sections.label: 系统
sections.html:
主控是 MadMapper。信号从 DJ 台进来：Beat Link Trigger 从 CDJ 读取实时波形与节拍，Ableton Link 同步 BPM，再分发到灯带、激光、警灯和钨丝灯。

  • 150 米点控灯带，2815 个像素点，经 Art-Net 控制器驱动
  • 638nm 红色激光头与旋转警灯，经 DMX512 继电器控制
  • 全彩动画激光：MadMapper Laser 模块 → Pangolin BEYOND → FB4
  • 钨丝灯：E27 T300，DMX512 Dimmer 调光
  • iPad 经 OSC 接入 MadMapper，甲方可无线改色（交付后更新加入）
  • 辅助控制：单片机 + 传感器

sections.label: 施工
sections.html:
布线、吊装、调试都在营业时间之外完成，白天场地照常交还。3 人 5 天，共 15 个工；灯带、激光、警灯和钨丝灯一次接通。

  • 预算：约 7 万元
  • 周期：2 周，从方案到落地，不影响正常营业
  • 现场：3 人 × 5 天，共 15 个工
  • 灯带：150 米，每米 60 灯，共 2815 点控
  • 激光：638nm 红色激光头 + 全彩动画激光

sections.label: 结果
sections.html:
全自动运行：程序跟随 DJ 的 BPM，店里不需要专职灯光师，也不需要专门维护。

交付后已更新 2 次，其中一次加入 iPad 控制界面；售后由我本人负责。灯亮着，才算交付。

head: A dance floor visual driven live by the CDJs: light that breathes with the BPM and the waveform
metaDescription: A lighting installation for the dance floor at Pillbox, Beijing: 150 m of pixel-controlled LED tape, 2,815 pixels and 638 nm lasers, driven live by the CDJs. Approx. RMB 70,000, delivered in two weeks.

infos.label: Type
infos.value: Dance floor visual / new media lighting installation

sections.label: The room
sections.html:
Pillbox is an underground club in Beijing. The brief was a visual above the dance floor that follows the DJ, built without closing the venue. Budget around RMB 70,000; timeline two weeks.

Under ten hours of initial conversation. The scheme, fixture positions, power and the control chain were settled on paper before anyone went on site. The build was three people over five days — 15 person-days. I covered communication, design, programming and delivery — one person, end to end.

sections.label: Design
sections.html:
A transparent spiral duct structure hangs above the dance floor, threaded with 150 m of pixel-controlled LED tape and cable. Tungsten lamps, lasers and rotating beacons are arranged along it.

The installation runs no presets. CDJ waveform and BPM feed the system in real time; the LED tape and lasers track the beat. When the DJ changes track or tempo, or pushes to a peak, the light moves with it. An iPad control interface was added after handover, so the client can change colours wirelessly.

sections.label: System
sections.html:
MadMapper is the main controller. Signal comes in from the DJ booth: Beat Link Trigger reads live waveform and beat data from the CDJs, Ableton Link syncs BPM, and the signal is distributed to LED tape, lasers, beacons and tungsten lamps.

  • 150 m of pixel-controlled LED tape, 2,815 pixels, driven through an Art-Net controller
  • 638 nm red laser heads and rotating beacons, controlled through DMX512 relays
  • Full-colour animation laser: MadMapper Laser module → Pangolin BEYOND → FB4
  • Tungsten lamps: E27 T300, dimmed through a DMX512 dimmer
  • iPad into MadMapper over OSC, for wireless colour control (added in a post-handover update)
  • Auxiliary control: microcontroller + sensors

sections.label: Build
sections.html:
Cabling, rigging and commissioning all happened outside opening hours; the room was handed back for daytime use. Three people, five days, 15 person-days. LED tape, lasers, beacons and tungsten lamps were all brought online in one pass.

  • Budget: approx. RMB 70,000
  • Timeline: two weeks from design to handover, with no disruption to normal business
  • On site: 3 people × 5 days, 15 person-days
  • LED tape: 150 m, 60 pixels per metre, 2,815 pixels in total
  • Lasers: 638 nm red laser heads + full-colour animation laser

sections.label: Result
sections.html:
It runs fully automatically: the program follows the DJ's BPM, so the venue needs no dedicated lighting operator and no routine maintenance.

Two updates since handover, one of which added the iPad control interface. I handle after-sales myself. It only counts as delivered while the lights are on.
